trap.label: pedido indireto
trap.wrong: Could you to close the window?
trap.why: Em português “poderia fechar” aceita a estrutura com infinitivo depois. Em inglês, após Could you use verbo na forma base, sem to.

mcq.q: “Do you have a minute?” often precedes...

fix.right: Do you have a minute to talk?

fix.wrong: I am sure you did your best, but is not good.
fix.right: I am sure you did your best, but it is not good.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva como pedido indireto: “Close the window.”
Reescreva sendo diplomático: “That is wrong.” (With respect,…)
